method.descriptives: All acquired panels including raw counts and incomplete diagnostic panels; finite nonmissing cells only, explicit expected27 missing count. No imputation. Population SD denominator n. R7 linear-interpolated quartiles. CV = population SD / arithmetic mean for positive ratio-scale measures.
method.correlations: Full27-region panels only, correlationEligible true. Pearson and Spearman with average tied ranks; no pairwise deletion. Absolute0.85 flags either coefficient, Pearson flag separately. Raw counts, population, incomplete panels, invalid program percentages and mortality ratios with unresolved definitions excluded.
method.interpretation: Ecological descriptive diagnostics, not causal, individual or measurement-error-adjusted. High coefficient alone never determines rejection.
method.coreConditionalDecision: Standalone UHH assumes aggregate IPM is absent in next methodology, as recommended by earlier audit. This does not authorize production changes.
